notes.title: Update 0.5.2 - Patch Note
notes.notes:
Judgeball: Lethal Arena - Update 0.5.2 - Patch Note - Wednesday September 13 2023

### New features

- New equipment menu UI
- Goal keeper's best friend
- Hero pose in end game score screen
- Redeem code
- Angel's fly kick (during lift off and landing)
- New tutorial objectives UI
- Demon's ability with ball in hands
- New light armors
- Mind ultimate friendly fire

### Improvement

- Forbid mapping several actions on the same input
- Hide ingame control helper panel with a controller
- Improve tackle's feedback SFX and VFX
- Improve gamepad navigation in menus
- Copy player's username in clipboard on click
- Show tackle/punch cooldown on reticle when down/fatalizable/invulnerable
- Add ultimate duration cooldown in UI 
- Fatality sequencer shows score has changed
- New death game VFX (lava)
- Add message in client lobby indicating which players must be ready to start the matchmaking when being in a team
- Remove pass VFX on ally when player is in shooting animation
- Improve Balog's catch collider
- Disable and cancel all inputs when player is in "Warming up the crowd" state
- Keep teams composition in private after a game
- Remove draw column from leaderboard
- Disable private panel UI once leader started matchmaking
- Mind ultimate target's empowering
- Spectator mode set to automatic mode after respawn
- Preserve equipment choices after a game
- Add a setting to hide the controls helper on a match start
- Add social icons in game stats results screen
- Forbid ultimate cooldown less than 10 seconds inside the practice mode
- Cyborg's shockwave does not make loosing the ball anymore
- Cyborg's shockwave range decreased (half of the arena)
- Make demon eligible for a pass when invisible
- Forbid punch/tackle during invulnerability state
- Add bonus tooltip inside the "Equipment" panel
- Clearer information when an item cannot be equipped because of the gear score
- Dynamic punch/tackle cooldown according to the character's corpulence
- Grant score to Mind during ultimate control
- Make the camera movable when character is down
- New characters portrait
- New ingame gamepad helper image
- Hide automatically the crowd if graphic quality is not set to ultra
- Dynamic AI combat cooldowns based on the difficulty
- Make AI GK less strong against magnus shots based on the difficulty

### Bug

- Character spawn looking at his goal's direction before turning around
- BAAW boomerang sometimes does not trigger
- Ready poises are not correct after having done a game
- Goal splash screen displayed after the sequencer
- Player can do a pass to a teammate which is behind or down
- BAAW goes through the enemy even if punched
- Angel's fly small wings sound is not spatialized
- Character is ramping quite fast when put down for a fatality
- Character's tackle animation "cancelled" by a punch
- Names of new players are not displayed in the top UI until a global respawn
- Teammate has its name displayed in red after a first spawn
- Mouse not available on in game "Options" menu if it was displayed before/during a sequencer
- BAAW sometimes does not rebound back on character's hit
- Player is joining the second spectator slot first in the private panel
- Fatality VFX not completely displayed if graphics are set to low
- Camera in the wall when being on the left/right side of the goal death zone
- Substitute and end game score panels are overlapped
- "Shop" and "Equipment" menus overlap inside client lobby if pressed next to each other
- Character's description is not displayed in server lobby
- Player's camera movement is not working after a respawn if not moving the character first
- Gail and Cymoril not on the floor during Mind's normal fatality
- "Unbound" gamepad key displayed on the "Position" button inside the server lobby
- Pass is not caught by a teammate in tackle animation
- Tiny Balog seeing the pass indicator on teammate
- Mind does not have the control UI if taking damage/falling down during the previous control
- Gail's vibroblades stay active after the ultimate if a tackle has been done
- Character is playing the "fall hit" animation twice
- Cymoril falling from fly to "down" position after having received a cyborg's shockwave
- Backward arm animation when character is trying to catch a ball which is going over

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 - Beta Update - Patch Note
notes.notes:
Judgeball: Lethal Arena - Update 0.5.0.10973 - Patch Note - Friday 21 April 2023

Open Beta release

** Major updates **
- Quest System
- Magnus shot improvement
- New Field of View options
- New resolution options
- In-game textual chat
- Alpha rewards
- Mind is (nearly) ready but will be deployed a bit later on

** Minor updates **
- An option in the menu to help us investigate
- An option in the menu allowing you to reset your data
- IAs improvements
- Delay between the hits a character can receive has been removed
- You can now collect an energy can if it spawns on you
- It's now easier to pick the ball up from the floor
- New FX feedback when you're hit by a shockwave

Include various bug fixes to improve the game stability
